wars.outcome: May 1874: a major rebellion in Jolof, the alliance with Lat Jor defeated at Coki; 11 February 1875 Amadou Ba killed at Samba Sadio; September 1875 he drove off Bara Ba; 1881 he beat a rival claimant and Bara Ba at Jame Njay; 1886 he defeated the French-backed damel of Cayor at Gile; 1887 his support for allies in Rip and Sine failed against French-backed opponents.
wars.note: The page gives April 1885 as a temporary treaty that ended a famine caused by a French commercial blockade.

notes:
Jolof Kingdom (the rump of the Jolof Empire), additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Pages: Jolof Empire, Alboury Ndiaye, Maba Diakhou Ba. This is the `jolof-kingdom` slug named as successor in the jolof-empire dossier.

The Jolof Empire page is silent on everything after 1549 except "by 1600 effectively over"; the rump state's history is the Alboury Ndiaye page (1875-1890). Between 1549 and 1865 no event is dated (page silent): the Denianke tribute (futa-toro ledger carries Jolof among the tributaries from 1599 to 1776) and Cayor/Baol attacks are not on the page. The end is 1890 (page: "by 1890" the only independent kingdom); the French protectorate date and the Dékhélé battle are not on the page. The Louga region is a proxy. The capital Warkhokh/Yang-Yang uses the Linguère coordinates.
